extractions.description: The paper explores machine learning approaches to improve code efficiency by analyzing competitive programming data. It specifically proposes a novel discrete variational auto-encoder to guide programmers in writing high-performance code, potentially reducing the carbon footprint associated with computing by optimizing code execution.
